verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has a dedicated pre-commit hooks doc with concrete setup (`git commit` hook script, `--since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail`), husky integration, repo-wide hooksPath setup, pre-receive hook alternative for server-side blocking, and a documented bypass (`--no-verify`). Hands-on probe confirms the CLI actually exits non-zero (183) on found secrets, which is exactly the signal a pre-commit hook needs to block a commit. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of the pre-commit hook specifically (not just the CLI) and evidence of official packaging via the pre-commit framework's hooks registry.
